usage: deskops list atoms [-h] [--root ROOT] [--axis-value AXIS_VALUE]
                          [--conv CONV] [--type ATOM_TYPE] [--all]
                          [--format {text,json}]

List atoms.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT           Target repository root.
  --axis-value AXIS_VALUE
                        Filter atoms by the configured atom_folder_axis
                        namespace value (e.g. licitaciones).
  --conv CONV           Filter atoms by conversation thread: conversation_ref
                        equal to it or starting with '<thread>/'.
  --type ATOM_TYPE      List only the atoms of this type (atom.adr); a typed
                        list shows by default only those in force (accepted).
  --all                 With --type, also list the superseded ones.
  --format {text,json}  Output format.
